title: MEXT Scholarship: IGP Special Quota
about: Japanese Government (MEXT) scholarship quota for Hokkaido University's International Graduate Program, October 2027 admission. Applicants first secure a supervisor's agreement and contact supervisors by November 10, 2026; the supervisor submits documents to the IGP office.
